notes.title: Update v1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Update v1.0.0.1 is now available featuring:
- The game now should start normally everytime you press play on Steam (Hopefully!);
- A bunch of perfomance optimizations (courtesy by Ratalaika Games when porting the game to consoles).

Thank you so much for playing Steel Racer everyone! I'm so grateful for all your support and kind words!
